title: Istanbul and Cappadocia
coverAlt: Hot-air balloons over Cappadocia at sunrise

gallery.alt: Hot-air balloons over Cappadocia at sunrise
Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, Istanbul

overview: Where Europe meets Asia. Three nights in Istanbul cover the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, a Bosphorus cruise and the Grand Bazaar, then a short flight takes you to Cappadocia for two nights in a cave hotel and a sunrise balloon ride over the fairy chimneys.

itinerary.description: Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace and the Grand Bazaar with a guide.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus cruise
itinerary.description: Morning cruise between Europe and Asia, afternoon at the Spice Bazaar and Galata.

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Short flight to Kayseri, then Göreme open-air museum and the valleys.
